recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future stewardship of the financial task code definitions should be handled in HL7 Terminology/THO rather than by restoring ProcessRequest or broadening core TaskCode.
issue_request: FHIR-18009 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FM change request asking to add `release` to the ProcessRequest.action code set for release of remaining reservations; the accepted resolution said ProcessRequest would be deprecated in favor of Task and the change would be made on Task instead.
initial_application: No FHIR-18009-keyed git commit was found. The apparent application is the November 2018 Paul Knapp `GF #19345` history: bbc5d920 added financial-management Task examples including `task-example-fm-release.xml`, and 0a36b9 added the financial task code system/value set including `release`.
additional_context: Current `source/fhir.ini` comments out ProcessRequest in active build configuration while Task remains active. The Task release example still uses `http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/financialtaskcode` with code `release`; the local core ValueSet includes that THO system. The local CodeSystem was later removed from core by the UTG-content removal commit, and current HL7 Terminology still publishes the `release` concept.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Editing the out-of-build ProcessRequest action list would contradict the Jira resolution, and adding `release` to the generic normative TaskCode code system would be broader than the FM-specific Task/financial-task-code application already present.
